title: Abandonia (2015): 776.1K accounts breached
summary: In November 2015, the gaming website dedicated to classic DOS games Abandonia suffered a data breach resulting in the exposure of 776k unique user records. The data contained email and IP addresses, usernames and salted MD5 hashes of passwords.

title: Edmodo: 43.4M accounts breached
